messages.subject: Contiuous integration with Atlassian Bamboo
parts: I know that most of the open source projects are working with Travis, but for people working within the Atlassian stack, maybe the shell script at https://gist.github.com/ojessen/8691544 will save them some minutes of googleing. It shamelessly references the work done by https://github.com/craigcitro/r-travis. What I am still working on is getting Bamboo to understand, process or whatever the results of the unit-tests, and maybe returning the finished package. After committing and pushing to origin the CI server uses the simple plan of 1. pulling from origin, and calling the script.
